title: Mount Juliet Home on 1 Acre Private Outdoor Space
description:
Single-story three-bedroom home on a private one-acre lot, about 30 minutes from downtown Nashville. Sleeps eight with a king bed, two queen beds, and a queen sofa bed. Enjoy a full kitchen, gas fireplace, furnished deck, Wi-Fi, in-building laundry, and driveway parking for two vehicles. Pets are welcome; smoking and parties are not allowed.

The space
Mount Juliet Charmer is a quiet, single-story three-bedroom, two-bath home set on a private one-acre lot. It sleeps up to eight guests with one king bedroom, two queen bedrooms, and a queen sofa bed in the living room.

The home includes a comfortable living area with a gas fireplace and TV, a full kitchen, dining space, Wi-Fi, central air and heat, and in-building washer and dryer access. Outside, the furnished deck overlooks the wooded back of the property. Driveway parking is available for two vehicles.

The home is convenient to Mount Juliet dining and shopping, nearby parks and lakes, and is about 30 minutes from downtown Nashville.

Pets are welcome. Smoking and parties are not allowed. Check-in is 4:00 PM and checkout is 10:00 AM.

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.

Other things to note
We give our guests space - but we are available when you need us. We are available Monday - Saturday 9 AM - 9 PM via Messenger. Your privacy and comfort is our highest priority!
